{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:verb:wake","kind":"instruction","text":"VERB wake. Once KMP is invoked, use kmp_wake before re-deriving known work. Do not use it as an all-abouts search. Minimum input: the exact about. Optional: as_of, interval and axis bound the packet in time — its evidence, spine, resume cursor and proof stand on the selection. Expect: compact current state, causal spine, open loops, next actions, a resume cursor and labels — the catalogue of the about, each label as key=value (a coordinate's dimension kind and scope id) with how many entries stand in it and when one was last observed, the current about first and then by use. Read the labels before naming one on a new memory: reuse what exists in scope, and know that a dimensions filter hides what it misses instead of ranking it low. The most used labels come first in the packet; the rest page, so raise budget.max_bytes or follow the cursor for the whole catalogue. Next: inspect or trace consequential refs; use the cursor to move forward when catching up.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787875320:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787875320:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":3},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":3},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-basic","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":3}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"basic","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:verb:ask","kind":"instruction","text":"VERB ask. Use kmp_ask for a semantic question that stored evidence can answer. To enumerate a period — yesterday, since, what changed, current or latest — navigate time instead. When the semantic question carries a date or a range, it is still one Ask: pass the half-open UTC interval as interval, or the instant as as_of, and axis when the question is about when something was seen, written or held rather than when it happened; the kernel admits only what falls inside, reads supersession and expiry as they stood then, and declares where it stood in proof.interval, proof.as_of and proof.axis. Minimum input: exact about and the question rendered in plain English with every number, identifier and acronym the user wrote kept exactly, plus the user's own words as asked_as. Expect: cited stored text byte for byte or UNKNOWN, asked_as echoed, a warning when the rendering dropped an identifier or leans to another language, and on UNKNOWN within an interval the nearest match outside it in proof.nearest_outside, which is the cue to widen the interval rather than conclude the memory was never written. Next: inspect a relied-on ref, trace a relied-on connection, re-ask at most once in the user's own words, or stop honestly at UNKNOWN.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787875380:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787875380:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":4},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":4},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-basic","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":4}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"basic","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:verb:relate","kind":"instruction","text":"VERB relate. Use kmp_relate when the question is what the memories of several abouts have to do with each other: which facts of these projects fell in the release window, how they stand to each other in time inside the labels they share (the same dimension kind and scope; a scope under two kinds is two labels), what each about declared between its own facts, and which declared contradictions still stand. Abouts are never joined by relations, so this is read off the coordinates and declared by nobody. Minimum input: the current about and dimensions.scope naming or sweeping the abouts; interval and axis bound it in time. Expect: facts with their lifecycle state at the end of the interval, declared relations within each about, coordinate relations between abouts with a why a reader can check against the coordinates, tensions, proposed links between facts of different abouts that share a key — an identifier rare across the span, a matching English summary, a proper name — with the signals that read them and never stored, and a proof that says which abouts were read and which had nothing inside. A proposal a writer declares with kmp_write_memory as same_event_as or same_entity_as comes back declared, and from then on ask cites through it across abouts and trace walks it. Next: inspect a fact before relying on it; ask when what you want is an answer to a question rather than the shape of what happened.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787875440:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787875440:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":5},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":5},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-basic","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":5}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"basic","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:verb:write","kind":"instruction","text":"VERB write. Use kmp_write_memory when a durable decision, constraint or outcome is reached. Use low-level kmp_ingest only when producing the exact graph. Do not store transcripts. Minimum input: exact about, intent, actor, observed time, scope, current fact in the language of the work, its English search summary (current.summary_en, required by a strict write when the fact is not written in English) and direct evidence. Label the write: scope.process always, scope.task and scope.episode as the two well-known labels, and labels {key: value} for any other facet; read the labels catalogue kmp_wake returned and reuse what exists — a value already used under another key is refused, and a new label that resembles an existing one (same identifier up to case and separators, or the same value under another key) is refused by a strict write naming both, written with labels.resembling by a lax one, and left alone when options.labels_new insists. Expect: validated relation quality, read-after-write readiness, and labels.written with labels.created after a commit. Next: inspect the generated ref when the write matters. One relation may cross an about, and only from here: same_event_as or same_entity_as to a ref of another about, class evidential, with why, evidence and the kmp_relate proposal in read_context.relate_proposals; the edge lives in the about that writes it and the other about does not change.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787875620:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787875620:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":8},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":8},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-basic","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":8}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"basic","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:advanced:scope","kind":"constraint","text":"Cross-about reads are explicit. dimensions.scope=current_about is the safe default. Use scope=abouts with a non-empty abouts list when the question deliberately combines memories; all_abouts is a real sweep, narrowed by dimension kind with mode=only and include, or by exact scope with scope_ids. The proof names the abouts a recall read in abouts_selected, the current one first, and, bounded by as_of or interval, the ones with nothing inside it in abouts_empty_in_selection. Abouts are opaque identifiers and are never joined by relations.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787875800:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787875800:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":11},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":11},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-advanced","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":11}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"advanced","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:advanced:relations","kind":"constraint","text":"Relations carry the why. A rich relation has a specific type, semantic class, why, concrete evidence and confidence. {"id":"guide:kmp-agent:advanced:lifecycle","kind":"instruction","text":"Supersession, contradiction and expiry mean different things. supersedes says a later state replaces an older one while preserving history and why. contradicts keeps two live claims in tension. valid_until ends applicability without requiring a replacement.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787876100:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787876100:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":16},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":16},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-advanced","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":16}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"advanced","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:advanced:reach","kind":"instruction","text":"Ask proof can carry memory the question never matched. An evidence item with reached_by arrived by a route instead of by its words: relation means a proven causal or motivational edge was walked out from something the question did match, named by reached_from, reached_via and reached_hops; association means this store's own vocabulary connects the question's words to that memory's; bridge means the installed lexical-bridge table connects a few of the question's words to that memory's across a language, and reached_via lists the pairs, as valvula≈valve 0.51. Read them as proof and never as the answer. They are not cited in because, and the kernel makes no claim that they answer anything. A cited item may instead carry bridged_terms: it answered, most of the question reached it through the table rather than in the reader's own words, and confidence is medium at most for that reason. A cited item carrying restated_from and restated_via is the same thing as a cited memory in other words: a writer declared it with restates, same_event_as or same_entity_as, with why and evidence, and the kernel cites it beside the memory the question matched.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787876160:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787876160:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":17},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":17},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-advanced","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":17}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"advanced","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:advanced:language","kind":"constraint","text":"The question is asked in English; the answer is given in the user's language. The kernel matches words and never translates, and what reaches a memory written in any language is its English summary_en, so a semantic question is rendered in plain English with every number, identifier and acronym kept exactly, and the user's own words travel as asked_as: searched never, echoed on the answer, and read against the question so a rendering that lost an identifier or leans to another language draws a warning while the question is still searched. The kernel accepts any language: a question in the store's own language reaches the stored text directly, and with a lexical-bridge table installed a citation that crossed a language names its word pairs in bridged_terms at medium confidence at most. If the English rendering returns UNKNOWN or the evidence does not answer, re-ask at most once in the user's own words and stop. Evidence text, refs, relation why and source metadata are cited byte for byte. There is no language setting.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787876220:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787876220:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":18},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":18},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-advanced","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":18}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"advanced","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:advanced:summary","kind":"constraint","text":"An English search summary is searched and never cited. A memory written in any language may carry the reserved entry metadata key summary_en: an English rendering of its text, written by the writer at ingest, that an English question lands on. kmp_ask searches it as content, beside the text, and cites the stored text byte for byte, so the summary is where a writer canonicalises jargon, rollout slipped as launch postponed, while the memory stays what somebody wrote. A cited item carrying matched_via: summary was reached through the rendering and not through its text, and summary_terms names the question's words the rendering supplied; read them as the writer's words, not the memory's. The kernel lints it rather than trusting it: kmp_ingest warns, entry by entry, about a summary that leans to another language, carries fewer than two informative words, repeats the text word for word, or drops an identifier the text carries such as v0.7.0, #469 or kmp-mcp, and ranking makes the same reading, so such a summary carries nothing. kmp_write_memory takes it as current.summary_en: a strict write requires it when the fact is not written in English and refuses one that fails the lint, naming every fault. Fix the summary the error names; never alter the text to fit it. A memory written before summaries existed still owes one: kmp-mcp summaries pending lists them and the doctor counts them; attach each with kmp_write_memory, intent record_summary, current.ref and current.summary_en only, and the stored text stays exactly as it was.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787876280:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787876280:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":19},{"dimension":"audience","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:audience-agent","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":19},{"dimension":"depth","scope_id":"about:guide:kmp-agent:dimension:depth-advanced","ingested_at":"unix:101788561281:653727229","sequence":19}],"metadata":{"audience":"agent","depth":"advanced","guide_version":"1","source":"editorial"}}

{"id":"guide:kmp-agent:tool:kmp_ask","kind":"reference","text":"LIVE TOOL kmp_ask. Retrieve stored entry text and evidence bearing on a question, or UNKNOWN. Nothing is generated: `answer` names what was retrieved and the text lives in `proof.evidence[].text` — `metadata.proof_role` distinguishes an entry claim from stored evidence. Read it and judge whether it answers. `proof.confidence` is lexical term overlap between the question and the best-matching memory item; it is not a judgement that the item answers, and it is not the `confidence` on a relation, which is writer certainty. A citation that crossed a language through the lexical-bridge table is capped at medium and carries `bridged_terms`; one the writer's English `summary_en` carried is not capped and carries `matched_via: summary`. An evidence item with `reached_by` arrived by a route rather than by the question's words and is proof, not an answer.
